changes: Optional research/RUN-closeout-scope.json switches only that run to exact scoped ownership. Missing tracked policy fails rather than restoring global staging. Other policy-absent runs keep their closeout behavior; run slugs are validated.

Required scope resolves all selected pages/current items/category pathways, plan and published ledger, final receipt/readiness/report/closure carriers, Git-eligible RUN-prefixed research, and recorded published-repair claims. Required absent/ignored carriers and unsafe paths fail closed.

Additional shared supporting changes require exact regular-file raw SHA-256 (or tracked deletion), concrete ownership reason and matching current-run owned_paths evidence. No broad directory/wildcard allowlist; whole-file ownership must be honest.

Temporary index plus literal NUL-delimited git add --all and git commit --only stages/commits exact owned paths. Only owned HEAD entries are integrated into the real index using update-index --index-info. No reset/checkout or whole-tree scoped commit.

Existing final dispatch receipt contains outside index mode/OID/stage/flags, outside HEAD and working-byte/mode counts/digests as a precommit baseline. Tool return and later --check require exact outside equality and every current owned artifact committed. No transcript contents copied.

Existing proof-layout, terminal-obligation, report integrity/evidence/response and publication-readiness require-report checks run unchanged. No canonical engine stage/revision/native model/config/gate changes.

All other active hooks and active filters/external fsmonitor, redirected Git/config environment, active Git operations, split index/submodules/conflicts/unsupported paths fail closed. Only fixed reviewed_hook name/path/hash/absence semantics permit the existing inert post-commit hook; source and guard reverified before/after every index mutation and commit and at final verification. No hooks/filters disabled, configuration changed, push or publication.

Staged/working/net Git rename views and ambiguous opposite-ownership D+A pairs including untracked destinations fail closed. Owned bytes, scope inventory/context, HEAD/main and outside preservation rechecked around commit.

Dangling local policy symlinks select scoped refusal rather than legacy fallback. Previously committed deletion tombstones stay in receipt/check ownership without unmatched later Git pathspecs. Automatic-maintenance pre-auto-gc hook is included in refusal.

Root independently reviewed the installed fixed-hash post-commit hook guard. Optional strict reviewed_hook policy support is limited to this exact executable regular source/path and absent graphify-out. Normal installed hook execution remains enabled. Failure after a changed HEAD is reported explicitly without reset/checkout.

runtime_tests.reason: Developer prohibits software tests; parent forbids live closeout/commit. No test cases were added.

configured_filter_inspection: Read-only git config --get-regexp ^filter\..*\.(clean|process)$ returned code 1/no configured drivers. Runtime code additionally checks actual file attributes before Git working-state operations.
preservation_exclusions: current-run dispatch operational .log/.log.gz files; retained in place and never staged/copied
limitations: Commit path is unexecuted and behavior is not certified by parser checks. Root must independently review implementation.
Outside preservation uses semantic index entries plus flags, not identical binary index stat-cache timestamps. Existing staged objects/modes/flags and outside working bytes/modes are compared.

Requires all normal evidence/math and Git writers drained. Checks detect observed changes but do not atomically exclude external writers; a failure after Git creates a commit holds closeout, reports landed commit and does not undo it.
Ambiguous cross-scope deletion/addition rejection can conservatively hold unrelated simultaneous deletion/addition work; owner must reconcile actual ownership. No heuristic acceptance.
Regular exact owned files only; no owned symlinks, unsafe/control/non-UTF-8 paths, unresolved index conflicts, submodules or split index. Unsupported Git index debug output is a refusal.
No ownership of mixed unrelated hunks in an automatically owned file can be inferred; root must establish whole-file ownership before seals.
Ignored current-run artifacts other than excluded runtime logs remain outside and hashed in place. Runtime exclusions are not asserted immutable.
Policy and this code/docs/evidence must precede ordinary Step9 protected-tree seals; late additions invalidate normal seals and require ordinary current-carrier regeneration.

Installed hook support requires the exact reviewed_hook policy object. Any source/path/guard change or other active hook refuses closeout. Guard checks do not lock the filesystem against concurrent writers; ordinary drain requirement remains.
parent_handoff: Root reviews exact diff, serially commits only owned code/docs per CLAUDE, freezes actual run-local policy including exact reviewed_hook before Step9 seals and retains all ordinary guards. No live closeout or policy creation performed by this agent.

reviewed_installed_hook.name: post-commit
reviewed_installed_hook.disposition: Supported only by exact reviewed_hook policy entry; fixed source exits before graphify under verified absence guard. No hook/filter/config override; no hook executed by this helper task.

required_artifact_name_review_method: Static source reading, not a software test or gate execution. Required names match existing tools; no additional invented Step9 carrier names.
